# HM Nexora

> HM Nexora (https://www.hmnexora.app/) is the flagship academic operating system, study vault, and LMS companion built specifically for Virtual University of Pakistan (VU) students, created by It's Mughal.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Study Vault**: Over 27,650+ indexed course handouts, midterm solved past papers, finalterm past papers, short lecture notes, and solved quizzes covering all 402 Virtual University subjects.
- **In-App VULMS Companion**: Smart portal enabling seamless LMS navigation, fast-forwarding lectures, automatic quiz question extraction, and academic sync.
- **Mock Exam & MCQ Studio**: Real-time simulation of VU midterm and finalterm exams with customizable timers, auto-grading, instant solutions, and cloud scorecards.
- **Nexora AI Mentor**: AI-powered Virtual University tutor powered by Google Gemini and custom LLM inference for course concept explanations, code debugging, and study schedules.
- **Realtime Community**: Live subject-specific study chat rooms across all courses (CS101, CS201, CS301, MTH101, MGT101, PHY101, etc.) and encrypted 1-on-1 student peer messaging.
- **C++ Cloud Compiler**: In-browser and mobile IDE with fast compilation and standard I/O for CS201/CS304 programming assignments.
- **Universal Media & Video Downloader**: Fast HD video and MP3 audio downloader for YouTube educational playlists, VU video lectures, and TikTok study guides without watermarks.
- **Study Planner & CGPA Target Calculator**: Real-time CGPA calculator and task manager tailored to VU grading policies.
